temporalRoleTrends.definition: Within each scenario/phase/metric/role, compare median of first six chronological runs with median of last six; run identities and timestamps omitted.
temporalRoleTrends.interpretation: Observed within-cohort temporal/order patterns; correlations are descriptive and do not establish cause.

calibration.pooling: No A/A data pooled with same-side controls.

qualificationLimits: These counts describe same-side control instability and per-metric band breaches; 69/72 control flags do not mean all 78 metrics were unstable.
No metric key breached in all 24 controls; maximum for any key is 15/24. Thirty keys held in all 24.
QPC quantization is observed; clean Prepare p95 has 8-tick and 9-tick modes, where a one-tick step is 12.5% and 11.1% respectively.
The control replay alone does not qualify observer overhead, host quietness, or overall performance acceptance, and does not attribute temporal trends to a cause.
A/A calibration is a separate evidence stream and is not included in these counts.
